title: Publications
description: content/data/publications.json: papers shown on /publications (and the homepage, filtered to type "conference"), in the topic graph, the navbar search, llms.txt and the resumes. Array of entries.

authors.description: Author names in order, e.g. ["Jane Doe", "Ada Advisor"]. Names matching config.name (first and last word) or config.authorAliases are underlined in bold.

type.description: Publication kind; one filter tab per distinct value. Lowercase. Known values get friendly tab names: conference ("Papers"), workshop, preprint, poster. The homepage lists only "conference" entries. Other lowercase values (e.g. "journal") get their own tab.

conference.description: Venue, e.g. "Example Conference on Learning Systems (ECLS 2025)". Shown in bold and on the resumes.

description.description: One- or two-sentence summary shown under the venue; also searched.

tags.description: Topics. Tags equal to an entry of config.publicationCategories are the graph's category nodes; all other tags become subtopic nodes linked to the categories they co-occur with.

links.description: Buttons shown on the paper: an object mapping the button label to its URL, e.g. {"View Publication": "https://...", "View Pre-Print": "https://..."}. The resume title links to (in order) a DOI in bibtex, then "View Publication", "View Pre-Print", "View Source", "View Artifact", then the first link.

additionalProperties.description: URL (absolute, or a path under public/ such as /assets/slides.pdf).

bibtex.description: BibTeX shown by the Cite button (use \n for line breaks). A doi = {...} field is used as the resume link. When absent, a basic @inproceedings entry is generated.

badge.description: Highlight badge next to the title and on the resumes, e.g. "Spotlight", "Best Paper".

spotlight.description: Legacy form of badge: true shows "Spotlight", a string shows that text. Prefer badge.

date.description: Year or date. Only used for the year of the generated BibTeX when bibtex is absent.

link.description: Legacy single URL, only used by the generated BibTeX. Prefer links.

resume_link.description: URL the resume title links to, overriding the DOI/links lookup.

show_on_website.description: Set to false to hide the paper on the website, in search, the topic graph and llms.txt (llms-full.txt still lists it).
